operations.title: Nima directs Grothendieck to formalize composition of typed invariant-record algebras
operations.body: Directed next lane: formalize the category/system of typed invariant-record algebras. Objects should retain (sector substrate V, symmetry/groupoid G, invariant algebra A[V]^G or typed observable subalgebra, physical constructor provenance, support/chain/coherence resources). A morphism is not an arbitrary algebra map: derive necessary and sufficient conditions for a sector constructor F to induce contravariantly F*:A[W]^H→A[V]^G, including equivariance or a declared homomorphism G→H and physical-selection compatibility. Then test whether the conditional pi0 endomorphism-semiring action descends as natural operations on these algebras; do not infer this from commutativity alone. Use four bounded instances: D3 memory Q[q2,q3], flavor weak-basis invariant algebra, string scalar period-character algebra, cosmology paired-invariant algebra. For any lane lacking a family/object rather than one evaluated scalar, mark the morphism untyped. Return the minimal composable diagram or the first exact obstruction and its missing resource. Preserve all stated exclusions.

authority_basis.summary: The operator supplied Grothendieck's proposed next step in the active research program; Nima assigns the bounded abstract lane.
